name: pi-sandbox-dsh-sandbox
description: OS write-boundary backend for pi-sandbox-dsh (dsh single source): bwrap (Linux/WSL2) read-only base + workspace-write bind, no credential masking, no network unshare. Backend is a library imported by core (BashSpawnHook is synchronous).

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types test/sandbox.spec.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/classify.spec.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/bwrap-e2e.spec.ts
